ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Heterogeneous distribution across lobes; the right lobe exhibits a high ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels (~65%) to low-intensity (black) pixels (~35%), while the left lobe is predominantly low-intensity (~85%) with localized high-intensity speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe features a large contiguous high-intensity white region with vertical low-intensity black striations extending toward the trailing edge. Left lobe shows a dominant low-intensity base with stochastic high-intensity mottling concentrated near the distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 42 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray and surface occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, non-uniform serration with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 18 pixels. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits visible serrations, though the segment near the notch is obscured by spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a convex sweep with increasing curvature toward the distal tip; left lobe presents a steeply angled, nearly linear sweep from the notch to the apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, yellowish-brown circular clusters (barnacle colonization) are localized along the outer lateral margin of the right lobe and the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several low-intensity vertical linear disruptions (possible rake marks) are detected across the high-intensity pigment field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive ectoparasitic calcifications (barnacles) on the right lateral margin and left lobe apex; the right trailing edge shows significant irregular loss of margin integrity consistent with prior trauma.
